Eaton Vance Tax-Managed Buy-Write Income Fund is a closed-ended equity mutual fund launched and managed by Eaton Vance Management. The company has market cap of $389.16 million. It is co-managed by Parametric Portfolio Associates LLC. It has a 7.97 P/E ratio. The fund invests in the public equity markets of the United States.
